Oh, he had? When did Marshall come into the band then, Stan? '49?

After Marshall came in in the small group?
Marshall had not been in the band before the small group?
I don't think he had. I don't think that's there.

He was in the first -- when they first formed the group, then I wasn't there, you see?
And, then Jimmy Lewis and Gus Johnson, and then they had Charlie Rouse.
And Clark Terry. And, Marshall, and myself. Wasn't Marshall there during that period with Charles?
